invariants.assert: exactly one gate_final event exists for each of read, remember, acknowledge, answer, draft, act, escalate
every matched policy operation emits one operation_evaluated event, including no_change/rejected operations
every grant_decision emits one grant_evaluated event whether accepted or rejected
every default, explicit, conflict, condition-failure, missing-policy/gate or re-applied deny emits deny_applied
cause_event_ids reference only lower sequence numbers
every policy_matched event references one or more earlier matched selector_evaluated events
an inheritance_step expanding a parent precedes operations sourced through that parent
raw payload and secret values are absent
when enabled, event hashes use RFC8785-JCS + SHA-256 and each prev_event_hash equals the preceding event_hash
